name: ssd1680
title: SSD1680 e-paper
notes: BUSY is high while the glass changes; RES is the only way out of deep sleep. The glass keeps its picture with no power, and a change of all of it takes about 20 s.

datasheet.source: Solomon Systech SSD1680 Rev 0.14, June 2019, the copy of WeAct Studio (sha256 b28ec2b4...): SCL at 20 MHz at most to write, VCI 2.2 to 3.7 V
